subject: Encryption provenance & operator sampling: request for logs, runbook, and rotation SLA exception
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: audits@covenantaudit.com, procurement@bluehaven.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Encryption provenance & operator sampling: request for logs, runbook, and rotation SLA exception

Hi team —

Following our SIG/CAIQ intake call, Bluehaven has a couple of targeted asks before the audit window next week. We want to be efficient — please see the ask list below and confirm what you can provide by EOD Friday so we can bundle it for the auditor: 

1) Operator shift sampling (last 90 days): a CSV of operator IDs, shift start/end, actions related to HSM ceremonies and key import/export events. A small synthetic sample is fine to start as long as it maps to the real artifacts. (see attached stub: operator_shift_logs_sample.csv)

2) HSM attestation summary: high-level vendor attestation, firmware version, and the most recent tamper event log (redacted). Attach as a one-page PDF if possible (hsm_attestation_summary.pdf).

3) Rotation runbook diff: Bluehaven wants the exact runbook steps we executed for the March migration and a short diff against the canonical runbook. If we cannot provide the diff as an official document, a short narrative + the change log is OK (rotation-runbook-diff.txt).

4) Temporary rotation window SLA exception: the customer is asking for documented confirmation that we permitted a 4-hour staggered rotation during the cross-region migration on 2027-02-26 and that keys were pinned for the window. They need a short statement we can include in the audit evidence.

Notes/constraints: please redact operator auth tokens and full usernames (operator IDs only are fine); sampling should preserve the order of events. 

Kimberly / Ben — can you coordinate internal collection? I can handle doc packaging and the Drive link once we have the artifacts. Audits — if you need a different sampling format, call it out now.

thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: operator_shift_logs_sample.csv (CSV stub), hsm_attestation_summary.pdf (one-page stub), rotation-runbook-diff.txt (text diff stub)

From: audits@covenantaudit.com
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Encryption provenance & operator sampling: request for logs, runbook, and rotation SLA exception

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear list. For the operator sampling we can accept the CSV format as outlined. A couple of clarifying items before you ship: 

- We need the event type column to use the SIG standard taxonomy (e.g., OP_SHIFT_START, OP_SHIFT_END, HSM_IMPORT, HSM_EXPORT, KEY_ROTATION).
- For the HSM attestation, the auditor will prefer firmware and module serial (last 4 digits only) plus the vendor-signed timestamp. Redaction of IDs is fine but please include the signing chain as a separate file or a signed statement.
- The SLA exception statement should include: (a) start/end timestamps (UTC), (b) who authorized the exception (role + email), and (c) mitigation steps taken during the window (e.g., pinned replicas, increased caching TTL, rollback plan).

If you can provide a Drive link with the three artifacts and a short cover note (1 paragraph) we can reference it in the CAIQ appendix.

Best,
Covenant Audit Team
Covenant Audit Partners

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 14:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Encryption provenance & operator sampling: request for logs, runbook, and rotation SLA exception

Jasmine / Ben —

Quick status update from ops: we exported a 30-row masked sample of operator_shift_logs_sample.csv (columns: operator_id, shift_start_utc, shift_end_utc, event_type, event_ts_utc, event_details_redacted). Attached is the sample stub. We also pulled the last HSM attestation bundle; vendor signed timestamp present, serial truncated to last 4 digits.

Regarding the SLA exception statement — I spoke with the oncall manager who approved the migration exception. Draft below for review: 

"Redwood Inference confirms that a scheduled cross-region migration on 2027-02-26 required a staggered key rotation window. The rotation was executed between 2027-02-26T02:00:00Z and 2027-02-26T06:00:00Z. Authorization was granted by SRE Manager Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com). Mitigations during the window included: pinning primary key replicas for 4 hours, raising caching TTL on token bundles to 24 hours, and a rollback plan that re-instated previous key version on failure. No customer data was rekeyed without validation; all operations were logged to the HSM audit channel."

If that wording looks good I will convert it to a one-paragraph signed statement on letterhead and attach hsm_attestation_summary.pdf. Ben — can you add the rotation-runbook-diff.txt and upload all files to the Drive link Jasmine will create?

Kim

- operator_shift_logs_sample.csv is masked and includes the SIG event taxonomy in the event_type column. 
- hsm_attestation_summary.pdf includes vendor signing chain and truncated serial.
